STATE=BASE/'docs/harness-state.json'
PROGRESS=BASE/'docs/study-progress.json'
VARIANTS=['quantile5','quantile10','width5','tails5']

def read(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())

def write(p,d):
    p=Path(p);p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    q=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+'.tmp');q.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n');q.replace(p)

def fingerprint(p):
    p=Path(p)
    with p.open('rb') as f: sha=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
    return {'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) if p.is_relative_to(ROOT) else str(p),'sha256':sha,'size':p.stat().st_size}

def check(r):
    p=Path(r['path']);p=p if p.is_absolute() else ROOT/p
    a=fingerprint(p)
    assert (a['sha256'],a['size'])==(r['sha256'],r['size']),f'input drift {p}'

def save_source(p):
    p=Path(p);out=BASE/'docs'/('adapter-'+p.stem+'.json')
    d={'source':fingerprint(p),'source_text':p.read_text(),'purpose':'Exact temporary adapter source; remove executable at close, retain reconstructable audit.'}
    if out.exists(): assert read(out)==d,'source already frozen'
    else: write(out,d)

def harness(action,event=None):
    cmd=[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'backtest/scripts/maintenance/experiment_harness.py'),action,'--state',str(STATE)]
    if event is not None:
        p=TMP/'event.json';write(p,event)
        cmd+=['--event',str(p),'--expected-revision',str(read(STATE)['revision'])]
    result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True)
    if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError(result.stdout+result.stderr)
    return json.loads(result.stdout)

def grade(s,name):
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd
    count=s.groupby(level='datetime').transform('count').to_numpy()
    r2f=2*count*(s.to_numpy()/3.46+.5);r2=np.rint(r2f)
    assert np.max(np.abs(r2-r2f))<1e-7
    if name=='tails5': edges,denom=[5,20,80,95],100
    else:
        denom=int(name.removeprefix('quantile'));edges=list(range(1,denom))
    g=np.zeros(len(s),dtype=np.int8)
    for edge in edges:g+=r2*denom>2*count*edge
    return pd.Series(g,index=s.index,name='grade')
